If you’re looking for a great place to enjoy a picnic in Miami, consider **South Pointe Park**. ### Why South Pointe Park? | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1 Biscayne Blvd, Miami Beach, FL 33139 (just south of downtown Miami) | | **Scenic Views** | Overlooks the Atlantic Ocean and the Miami skyline – perfect for sunset picnics. | | **Amenities** | • Picnic tables & shaded areas
• Restrooms & showers

• Walking paths along the waterfront | | **Accessibility** | Easy access via public transit (Miami Beach Trolley stops nearby). | | **Nearby Attractions** | Close to the Miami Beach Boardwalk, shops, and restaurants. | ### Tips for Your Picnic - **Pack a blanket** or bring a portable chair if you prefer more comfort. - **Check the weather forecast**; it’s usually sunny but can get breezy near the water. - **Bring sunscreen** and stay hydrated—especially if you plan to stay until sunset. - **Leave no trace**: Take your trash back to the park’s designated bins or carry it out. Enjoy your time at South Pointe Park!
